data.title: 五河琴里 · 商业街双人分享草莓可丽饼
data.description: 热闹的商业步行街上，琴里双手举着一个大号草莓奶油可丽饼送到你的唇边。少女满脸通红却眼神骄傲，微仰着小脑袋满心期待你夸奖她的挑选。
data.location: bustling outdoor shopping pedestrian arcade with hanging paper banners
data.action: walking through festive shopping district, holding up a giant strawberry whipped cream crepe to partner mouth with blushing cheeks and proud grin
data.mood: delightful sweet date, youthful girlfriend energy, heartwarming romance
data.promptProse: Holding up a giant strawberry crepe to partner mouth, Kotori Itsuka blushes with a proud joyful grin under sunny street daylight.
